name: @reviewpilot/server
description: ReviewPilot as a GitHub App webhook service: debounces pushes per PR, stops stale reviews, and runs the action against warm clones.

scripts.build: esbuild src/main.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node24 --format=esm --outfile=dist/server.mjs --banner:js="import { createRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);"
